title: Dutch Stroop Pancakes
description: A traditional Dutch dessert consisting of thick pancakes smothered in a sweet stroop sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until combined.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve with warm Dutch stroop sauce.
